if: a change in an accounting estimate has occurred
then: its effect is included in determining net profit or loss in the period of the change if the change affects that period only, and in the period of the change AND future periods if it affects both; and it is classified using the SAME classification in the statement of profit and loss as was used previously for the estimate
note: Forward-only, never backward. Combined with ACC-PRIORPERIOD-ESTIMATE-001, this is the operational difference from a prior period item: an estimate change is recognised now and onward with no restatement, while an error correction is separately disclosed as a prior period item.

evidence.quote: The effect of a change in an accounting estimate should be included in the determination of net profit or loss in:
the period of the change, if the change affects the period only; or
the period of the change and future periods, if the change affects both.
an accounting estimate should be classified using the same classification in the statement of profit and loss as was used previously for the estimate.
